title: Feels and Looks Cheap
text:
The sizing is off, so I've re-subscribed to a different size, hoping that will fix the issue. Honestly, though, I don't know if the shirt value is there. This is my first Amazon t-shirt subscription, and the shirts don't feel soft at all, and seem cheap. It's not the Disney quality I expected from their t-shirts. Going to give it another month before I decide to cancel.

The first month's design is cute, but not I-want-to-always-wear-this cute. Kind of disappointed!
label: neutral
